Use Auto Transfer: to set how the controller automatically transfers data log files as they are completed.

Options: 
TFTP: transfer data log files to a TFTP server program running on the remote host computer. Enter the IP address of the host computer.

Samba: transfer data log files to a directory that is configured for network file sharing. Enter the user name and password  for a user with access to the shared directory, the IP address and name of the host computer, and the  path to the shared directory.

USB: transfer data log files to a flash drive connected to the controller.
